relations.subject: n1ql:create-primary-index
relations.evidence: Users executing the CREATE PRIMARY INDEX statement must have the Query Manage Index privilege granted on the keyspace.

relations.subject: n1ql:create-primary-index
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 7.0 and later, CREATE PRIMARY INDEX allows you to make multiple concurrent index creation requests.

relations.subject: n1ql:create-primary-index
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 6.5 and later, the index type for a primary index must be Global Secondary Index (GSI).

relations.subject: n1ql:with-nodes-primary
relations.evidence: [COMMUNITY EDITION] a single primary index of type GSI can be placed on a single node that runs the Indexing Service.

relations.subject: n1ql:create-primary-index
